notes.title: It's all about money - update.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34943148/73bb9dbe36594636b746742e43965fd27b3f253d.png[/img]

Reworked whole economy system in game. Money drops are more consistent, item prices in shop have little deviation from base price in both directions. Now Super Items in shop will be different from the Super Item, which you currently hold. Slot machines now have smaller chance to win, but prizes are bigger and prices are balanced.

notes.title: Polishing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added noise to background, so it doesn't look so static.
[*] Added broken swords, shields and helmets lying around for the climate of someone else fighting there before.
[*] Added floating rocks behind the rooms and also inside room in endless mode.
[*] Improved Swordman's AI.
[/list]
